problem:
Title: Structure of Correlation Matrix

Let $\sequence a_n$ and $\sequence b_n$ be [[Definition:Sequence|sequences]] of $n$ [[Definition:Observation|observations]].

Let $\mathbf C$ be the '''[[Definition:Correlation Matrix|correlation matrix]]''' {{WRT}} $\sequence a_n$ and $\sequence b_n$.

Then $\mathbf C$ is [[Definition:Symmetric Matrix|symmetric]] with [[Definition:Matrix Entry|entries]] on the [[Definition:Main Diagonal|main diagonal]] all equal to $1$.
